absolute_vs_relative_separation.principle: Meeting absolute quality gates (e.g. canonical validity >= 80%) demonstrates candidate baseline safety, but DOES NOT demonstrate superiority over Control. Relative improvement gates (Treatment wins > Control wins, p < 0.05) must be independently satisfied.

paired_relative_advantage.rule: Treatment wins > Control wins with two-sided McNemar p < 0.05 on confirmatory battery, or positive lower confidence bound on paired difference.

allowed_final_dispositions.QUALIFICATION_PASS: Satisfies Tier A Hard Gates, Tier B Absolute and Relative Quality Gates, and Tier C Operational Gates on Confirmatory Battery.
allowed_final_dispositions.SCOPED_QUALIFICATION: Satisfies Tier A and overall Tier B, but exhibits a localized deficit in one domain (e.g. Q3 entity overreach) requiring operational scoping or downstream containment.
allowed_final_dispositions.QUALIFICATION_FAIL: Violates any Tier A Hard Gate or fails overall Quality Gates.
allowed_final_dispositions.QUALIFICATION_INCONCLUSIVE: Sample size underpowered, high provider variance, or paired difference p >= 0.05 despite positive point estimate.
allowed_final_dispositions.QUALIFICATION_INVALID: Custody failure, truth manifest exposure, prompt drift, or protocol breach.
